title: Leaves of Grass: The First (1855) Edition
author: Walt Whitman
summary: The first edition of Whitman's landmark poetry collection, published in 1855, with a long preface and twelve untitled poems, including the one later called Song of Myself. It celebrates the self, the body, nature and democracy in free verse.
readIf: you want to read the raw, original version of a foundational work of American poetry.
skipIf: you prefer rhymed or tightly structured verse, or want the later, expanded editions.
